title: Utillian Glass Bubbler
description:
The all new Universal Utillian Glass Bubbler has been redesigned to accommodate a wider variety of Utillian vaporizers. Now featuring silicone adapters for a more secure fit.

This simple attachment allows for water cooled hits for an even smoother flavor off your favorite Utillian vaporizer.

Stop inhaling extra hot vapor with the help of the Utillian Water Bubbler. The Utillian Water Bubbler is a stylish and functional accessory for your Utillian 5 Wax Pen. When attached, this bubbler adds water filtration to your vape, cooling down your vapor and allowing you to extend your draws. You can enjoy the crisp feel of the vapor with all of its rich flavour thanks to the help of this bubbler. It is a must-have accessory for your Utillian vaporizer or wax pen.

The Utillian bubbler is easy to use. Partially fill the bubbler with warm water, then attach it over the mouthpiece of your vape. The extended size of the bubbler will create more room for your vapour to cool during the draw. The water in the unit will help cool the vapor as it moves through. The end result is a cool, crisp draw from your vape with all of the normal flavour. It is sure to make your vaping experience much more enjoyable.

Compatible with:
Utillian 2
Utillian 5
Utillian 420/421
Utillian 620
Dr Dabber Stella
Linx Blaze
Linx Hypnos Zero
Puffco Plus
Arizer Solo 2
DaVinci IQC
DaVinci IQ2
Dynavap M 2021
DaVinci Miqro
Arizer ArGo
Arizer Air 2
Linx Gaia
Arizer Solo

Order yours today.
